special_adjudications.question: Mobile navigation: currently unlabeled 32px navigation toggle
special_adjudications.answer: CONFIRMED in current source. The toggle is the <button> at Layout.jsx:30-35 inside the md:hidden header bar. Classes 'flex h-8 w-8 ...' => 2rem x 2rem = 32x32 CSS px at default root size (icon h-4 w-4 = 16px). Accessible name: NONE - no aria-label, no title, no visible text, no sr-only span; its only child is a lucide Menu/X svg. aria-expanded: absent. aria-controls: absent. Also no type attribute. The adjacent 'Skywatcher-PR' span (line 36) is a sibling, not a label. The overlay it opens (Layout.jsx:19-26) has no dialog semantics.

special_adjudications.question: Dialog semantics: every dialog/modal/drawer/sheet in the frontend
special_adjudications.answer: MOUNTED, all hand-rolled (no shared primitive): (1) SideDrawer, used by 7 drawers via DrawerHub (Observation, Aircraft, Capture, Route, Asset, Export, Review) - role=dialog: NO; native <dialog>: NO; aria-modal: NO; aria-labelledby/label: NO (title is a plain h2 with no id); focus trap: NO; Escape: YES (window keydown, SideDrawer.jsx:5-9); focus return: NO; initial focus move: NO; backdrop click closes; close button unlabeled. (2) Mobile nav overlay (Layout.jsx:19-26) - role=dialog NO, aria-modal NO, label NO, focus trap NO, Escape NO, focus return NO. NOT dialogs: Sky Cameras 'Contribute' and 'Review' are inline disclosure panels with aria-expanded (SkyCameras.jsx:438-453); toasts via ui/toaster. UNMOUNTED shared primitives present in the tree but imported by no page/feature component: ui/dialog.jsx (Radix Dialog), ui/alert-dialog.jsx (Radix AlertDialog), ui/sheet.jsx (Radix Dialog as sheet), ui/drawer.jsx (vaul), ui/command.jsx (cmdk in Dialog) - these would supply role/aria-modal/trap/Escape/return but are unused. No confirm dialog exists for destructive actions (e.g. 'Take down', SkyCameras.jsx:363).

special_adjudications.question: federationClient.js client calls with no backend route (bulk, auth/*, functions, integrations, files/upload, agents/*) and whether UI invokes them
special_adjudications.answer: No backend route exists for any of the following (all backend decorators enumerated in main.py, console/router.py, spacetrack_router.py, cameras_router.py). NOT invoked by any UI code: entities.bulkCreate POST /entities/{e}/bulk (:109); entities.delete DELETE /entities/{e}/{id} (:111); functions.invoke (:154); integrations.Core.InvokeLLM (:159), SendEmail (:160), ExtractDataFromUploadedFile (:161), UploadFile -> /files/upload (:166); agents.listConversations/getConversation/createConversation/addMessage/subscribeToConversation (:172-182); connectors.getConnection (:192); auth.logout -> /auth/logout (:145, reachable only through AuthContext.logout which no component calls). INVOKED by UI but only on auth pages that mount when authRequired (App.jsx:82-88; default backend reports requires_auth=false, main.py:1106): auth.loginViaEmailPassword (Login.jsx:22), auth.loginWithProvider (Login.jsx:32, Register.jsx:70), auth.register (Register.jsx:31), auth.verifyOtp (Register.jsx:44), auth.resendOtp (Register.jsx:59), auth.resetPasswordRequest (ForgotPassword.jsx:19), auth.resetPassword (ResetPassword.jsx:28) - all would 404. auth.me (:119) HAS a backend route but it unconditionally raises 401 (main.py:1148-1150). Additionally, client methods with a backend route but no UI caller: entities.filter, entities.get, flightCorpusV4.artifactMembers, spaceTrack.objects, spaceTrack.reentry.

special_adjudications.question: Write-token handling: where the frontend stores the write token and whether any UI lets the user enter it
special_adjudications.answer: Storage: window.localStorage key 'federation_write_token' (federationClient.js:13,18-27), plus an in-memory copy appParams.writeToken captured at module load (app-params.js:84). The only way it gets set is the URL query parameter ?write_token=..., which getParamValue writes to localStorage under federation_write_token and then strips from the URL via history.replaceState (app-params.js:35-49,84); ?clear_write_token=true removes it (app-params.js:64-66). It is sent as 'Authorization: Bearer' only when no access token is present (federationClient.js:65-66,72-74). UI entry: NONE - there is no input, form or settings surface for the token; setWriteToken is exported but has no caller (grep setWriteToken in src: definition only). The backend exposes public_settings.write_token_required (main.py:1108) but the frontend never reads it, so the UI cannot prompt; the only user-facing hint is the Review-queue 401/403 message 'Reviewing needs write access (a local network, or the PRII write token).' (SkyCameras.jsx:305). Token persists in localStorage in plaintext with no expiry. The backend comment at main.py:309-312 ('browser UI has no write-credential input ... sources only the federation access token') is partly stale: the client now does source a separate write token, but still offers no input.
